items.statement: CPU architecture, entry protocol, privilege model and memory map require explicit selection and target qualification.
items.feature: Versioned boot-information validator for architecture, address ranges, overlap and entry point
items.unknown_behavior: Reject malformed or unknown handoff metadata; do not infer physical platform support from a recognized ID.
verification: ABI magic, version and structure size are validated.
Memory range overflow and overlap are rejected.
Kernel region and entry point must agree.
A real boot path remains disabled until linker, entry and emulator evidence exist.
